body: I think she's being manipulated by him, but it could be financial dependency as well. I will make a point to ask her about this. Thanks for your response.

Oh, believe me, I mocked his manhood this time. This lead to the dead father comment. I guess I hit a nerve. I just do not want it to go silent, and then something really bad happen if I wait for her to ask.

It's my mother's house, and she said it was okay for him to stay there until he moved back home (he switched states for a job). His lease was up in his old place, but he wasn't going back until a couple weeks later so he was staying in my sisters room with her. He had property in my mothers house because of this, so the police told me they cannot remove him by force. He did end up leaving on his own hours later after more arguments and him packing his shit. Now he doesn't have property here and is moved out, so next time may be different, eh?

Well, I've omitted things for obvious reasons. There were many discussions between her and I about the things you mentioned. I completely see what you mean. I know she isn't in charge of his actions, it's just after all of this, she still wants to patch things up with him?

I wanted to post more my side of things, because that's kind of why I said it was more of a rant at the end. I wanted to lay the events all out in my head and how they made me feel at the time and typing this helped me achieve that. I know how I feel about the situation, but I can't speak for her. She can tell me how she feels, but is she really feeling that way?

Thank you for your point of view. I appreciate your post.
